title: Shared generator distance and carbon-monoxide log
summary: A neighbor or camp log for using a shared generator without bringing exhaust, fuel confusion, or cable hazards into living spaces.
content: Core sequence: 1) Place the generator outside and away from doors, windows, balconies, and air intakes before any cable is connected. 2) Name one operator for each run period and record start time, fuel amount, loads, smell complaints, and stop time. 3) Run only essential loads and keep sleeping areas separate from extension-cord routes. 4) Stop the generator at the first exhaust smell indoors, dizziness report, cable heating, rain exposure, or argument over unsafe placement.
